title: Get a permit for an advertising sign in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before putting an advertising sign or bill on a road, footpath, council property or other public place.

laws.title: Shire of Wiluna Local Government Property and Dogs Local Law 2007

sources.title: Shire of Wiluna Local Government Property and Dogs Local Law 2007 (adopting the Exmouth local law)
sources.locator: cl 3.13(1)(b) of the Exmouth local law, as made, Gazette No. 134, 10 Jul 2000; adopted with modifications, Gazette No. 118, 5 Jun 2007
sources.quote: A person shall not without a permit—

confidence_note: Quotes the local law as made, from the WA Government Gazette; WA publishes no consolidated local laws. The clause was found by a pattern search of every Gazette from 1996 to 2026 (E-8), and the law was taken as in force because no later repeal naming it was found. The council adopted the Exmouth local law with modifications (Gazette No. 118, 5 Jun 2007); the clause is quoted from that law as made. The adopting law modifies this clause, so the quoted words may differ.

assessment.summary: Advertising signs in public places need the council's permit.

marks.reason: A permit, fees and design rules for signs in public places.
